results.title: Adam’s Fire
results.overview: In the misty mountains of West Virginia, a grieving young boy who has lost all hope finds an unexpected friendship, a chance to heal, and the breathtaking power of forgiveness.

results.title: My Other Half
results.overview: In this tense urban thriller, grief opens the door to danger as Mia becomes the target of a calculated scheme, forcing her to outplay her predators before they finish the job they started.

results.title: Carlos Lacerda - A Voz que Abalou o Brasil

results.title: Deep Blue
results.overview: At 11 years old, Nicola has killed a man. It was his father, Lucio, who ordered him to do it. His reward? Abandonment. Twenty years have passed, and since that day Nicola has lived in Mexico with his uncle Nando, who raised him under a lie: Lucio was dead. A harsh upbringing in a ruthless country shaped him and taught him how to survive. Today, he's an adult working at the family restaurant, having buried the past under the weight of distance. But Nando decides to leave for good. On the eve of his escape, he chooses to reveal the truth: Nicola's father is still alive.

results.overview: 4th Rope Westside Gunn Day took place on 28.08.2025 and aired on YouTube on 17.2.2026

results.title: Nothing Left
results.overview: A group of queer people is kidnapped and dumped in the middle of nowhere. Are they left there to rot? Is this a concentration camp? Or a hunting ground where they are the prey? When you've got nothing left the only thing you can do, is find your way to resist.

results.title: All American Girls
results.overview: Directed by Conduit Films' founder Christy Wegener, All American Girls features a sit-down with Pleasant Rowland, as well as never-before-seen footage and insights from the American Girl brand's authors, insiders, enthusiasts and journalists. Stop-motion graphics aid the filmmakers as they venture behind the curtain of the brand, which shaped the lives of generations of Americans in the ’80s, ’90s and early 2000s, and maintains cultural relevance today.

results.title: A Mama Deola Wedding Story
results.overview: The story follows a fierce matriarch trying to fund her son's dream wedding while facing snobbish in-laws, chaotic wedding events, and a hidden hospital secret.

results.title: Conceivable
results.overview: When faced with an unexpected pregnancy, a couple in midlife must navigate their beliefs, relationships, and the support of their community. A compelling story that explores the complexities of family, faith, and the choices that define us.

results.title: Puca
results.overview: It is the early afternoon of a summer day in the 1990s. While their parents are asleep, Lotti and Malibù (nicknames the sisters use for each other) decide to sneak out to a local bar—a spot frequented by the boy they both have a crush on. Puca, the youngest, insists on coming along, threatening to wake their parents with her screaming if they refuse. The three girls set off; as they pass the beach, Puca wanders toward the water’s edge and claims to have seen a mermaid. Once at the bar, the older sisters—preoccupied with their adolescent moods—lose sight of Puca. A search ensues, leading to a confrontation that clears the air between them, followed by a fleeting glimpse of the mermaid diving and vanishing beneath the waves; that image makes them realize their childhood is gone forever. The unexpected happens when they return home to alert their parents…

results.title: Verily Hitler Is Dead
results.overview: United Europe, the Baltic Sea coast. It is the Day of Thanksgiving, the most important national holiday since the denazification of the late 1960s, carried out almost two decades after the end of World War II. A war won by the Nazis. Europeans denounced the crimes of Nazism and took on themselves the blames of the victors.

results.title: Magical Super Asia: The Old Monk and The Cat Monster
results.original_title: 深邃美麗的亞細亞：老和尚與貓怪
results.overview: As the blood moon approaches, Wu Hui, an old monk who has spent his life vanquishing demons, investigates a series of brutal Cat Monster killings, only to encounter Bai Bing Wei, a cursed young man, and Die Zi, a thousand-year-old yokai, revealing devastating truth about good and evil.

results.title: The Pale Snow and Kirin
results.overview: An outcast orphan discovers her royal lineage and joins forces with a dragon prince to save an ancient city from a reawakened evil.

results.title: Can’t Float
results.overview: A 30‑something year old Black man confronts his lifelong fear of the water, and the weight of US historical stereotypes about Black people and swimming, as he commits to finally learning how to swim.…in a class for children.

results.title: December, Day Zero
results.overview: A recovering alcoholic comes face-to-face with his bartender ex-girlfriend when he attempts to drop off a Christmas gift at her bar.

results.title: Goodbye Cruel World
results.overview: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

results.title: Hope Chest
results.overview: Class Assignment: An oral essay on your hopes and dreams for your future. Eve’s Opening Statement: “I hope the FBI agent who finds my body is predisposed to sadness.”

results.title: Strays
results.overview: Mati, a six-year-old girl, spends her last day with her foster siblings before being adopted. Guided by her protective older sister Valeria, the children sneak past the park fence and onto the train tracks, where they pass the time flattening pennies. But when Mati finds a dead cat, she insists on spending the day preparing a funeral for it.
